subject: Demo logistics for Elysian Health — in-person demo timing
messages:
From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@elysianhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elysian Field Ops <fieldops@elysianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo on-site during our roadshow?

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're running a small regional roadshow for our outpatient clinics the week of July 20 — I'll be on-site at St. Agnes on Tue/Wed (7/21-7/22) and traveling to the conference in Pittsburgh later that week. The team is interested in an in-person demo at St. Agnes if we can align timing.

Two asks: can you (1) confirm whether you guys can do an on-site, interactive demo of redwood inference ingest + restricted data flow in ~60 minutes, and (2) share any AV or room requirements so I can book it on my side?

If in-person isn't possible, a remote demo during our noon break on 7/21 would work.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Lemaire
Director, Clinical Innovation
Elysian Health

P.S. I've attached a one-pager about the St. Agnes visit schedule (attachment: st_agnes_visit_0726.pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@elysianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Demo on-site during our roadshow?

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on getting the roadshow lined up.

Short answer: yes, we can do an on-site interactive demo that covers data flow, private deployments, and a short Q&A. Monica can lead the technical portion, and I can run the product narratives & cost controls.

AV/room ask: a laptop HDMI + projector or large display, stable guest Wi‑Fi (or a way to test connectivity beforehand), and a small table for our gear. If you'd rather keep it remote, we can do a 45-minute focused session with a live model run and joint Q&A.

Proposed slots (local St. Agnes time):
- Tue 7/21, 10:00–11:00
- Tue 7/21, 12:15–13:00 (lunch short session)
- Wed 7/22, 09:30–10:30

Monica/Avery — can you confirm who can travel and what we need to make an on-site demo smooth? I attached the latest deck and a mutual-action plan for your review.

Attachments: redwood-demo-slide-deck-v2.pdf, mutual-action-plan_elysian.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elysian Field Ops <fieldops@elysianhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@elysianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 08:31:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Demo on-site during our roadshow?

Hey Jordan — quick note from operations: St. Agnes room availability just shifted. The only guaranteed slot with AV tech is Wed 7/22 09:00–11:30. The 10:00 and 12:15 Tue slots are no longer available because of a vendor lunch and an all-staff huddle.

We can reserve the 09:30–10:30 window on 7/22 if you confirm today so I can send the room invite and log AV.

— Tom (Facilities)
Tom Ruiz | Event Operations Manager, Elysian Health
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Demo on-site during our roadshow?

Jordan — I can cover an on-site technical demo on Wed 7/22 morning but I'll need travel approved and a per-diem. I confirmed the portable kit fits in a carry-on; no special networking gear required besides guest Wi‑Fi and a power strip.

If we need a second human for Q&A escalation, Avery can take the backup role remotely.

Avery — can you confirm remote backup for 7/22 09:30–10:30? Also tagging our travel ops contact for quick approval.

Thanks,
Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@elysianhealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <fieldops@elysianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Demo on-site during our roadshow?

Confirmed — Monica is booked to present on-site Wed 7/22 09:30–10:30 at St. Agnes. Jordan, I sent the travel approval to Ops and Finance. Sophie/Tom, Monica will arrive at 08:45 to test AV and we will bring the slide deck + a local inference demo (no patient data).

Agenda (high level):
- 08:45 — AV check / network test
- 09:00 — intro & deployment overview (Jordan)
- 09:15 — technical demo & sandbox run (Monica)
- 09:40 — Q&A and next steps / MAP sign-off

I'll also share a calendar invite with logistics and the Drive link to the deck. Looking forward to it.

Avery Johnson
Sales Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
